parameterdescription.para: Configuration parameters (or NULL for defaults: 4 pole pairs).

simplesect.para: SYN_OK on success, SYN_ERR_INVALID_PARAM if bldc is NULL.

briefdescription.para: Process 3-bit Hall sensor reading and update 6-step phase commutation gates.

detaileddescription.para: Call this from Hall sensor EXTI GPIO interrupts or input sampling loops.

parameterdescription.para: 3-bit Hall sensor state (bits [2:0] = H3, H2, H1). Valid: 1..6.
Pointer to output struct to receive new 3-phase gate states.

simplesect.para: SYN_OK on valid commutation step, SYN_ERR_FAULT if hall_state is 0b000 or 0b111.

briefdescription.para: Set PWM duty cycle for motor speed control.

parameterdescription.para: PWM duty cycle clamped to range 0..1000.

briefdescription.para: Stop motor driver (turn OFF all 6 gates).

parameterdescription.para: Optional pointer to receive updated OFF gate states.

briefdescription.para: Update Hall-based speed calculation (RPM) and speed PID loop.

parameterdescription.para: Target motor speed in RPM (used if speed PID is active).
